The '''Forbelea system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Forbelean Defense]] [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]] technique.<ref name="FHI">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Forbelean Defense]]|system=Forbelea [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Forbelea system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square H-8.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
